propositions: Diagnostic artifacts (diag-runaway-transcript.md, diag_runaway_transcript.py, diag_runaway_matrix.py) from commit 556708771e were committed but not landed on main, making ticket evidence unverifiable on the main branch.

The three diagnostic files follow an established convention in docs/experiments/ (paired live-diagnostic driver + findings write-up) and are reusable across future verifier step-floor changes, justifying their landing rather than de-citing.

The completion-verifier runaway loop persists on current main despite the runaway guard (_runaway_guard_toolsets); it clusters on TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE tickets where verification hunts across many files, suggesting root cause in context pre-selection rather than the guard itself.

Budget-anchoring measurement confirmed: verifier reaches sufficient evidence at ~100 tool calls / 25 requests but does not stop when given surplus budget (8x needed), indicating criteria-scaled step floor (Lever 1) should scale down from flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480.
